videos.headline: USC rallies behind Kennedy Smith to reach Elite Eight without JuJu
videos.description: Kennedy Smith steps up with 19 points, leading the Trojans past Kansas State and into the Elite Eight.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (USC rallies behind Kennedy Smith to reach Elite Eight without JuJu) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kennedy Smith drives hard for USC bucket
videos.description: Kennedy Smith attacks the lane and finishes strong to add to the Trojans' momentum.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kennedy Smith drives hard for USC bucket) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Rayah Marshall comes up with big block for USC
videos.description: Rayah Marshall protects the rim with a strong rejection.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Rayah Marshall comes up with big block for USC) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kennedy Smith goes coast-to-coast for USC bucket
videos.description: Kennedy Smith takes it the length of the floor and finishes strong for the Trojans.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kennedy Smith goes coast-to-coast for USC bucket) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Avery Howell hits USC 3 after steal to end 1st quarter
videos.description: Avery Howell caps the first quarter with a clutch triple off a takeaway to give USC a boost.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Avery Howell hits USC 3 after steal to end 1st quarter) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kennedy Smith turns defense into offense for USC
videos.description: Kennedy Smith jumps the passing lane and takes it coast-to-coast for an easy bucket.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kennedy Smith turns defense into offense for USC) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kayleigh Heckel joins the fast-break fun for USC
videos.description: Kayleigh Heckel sprints the floor and caps the transition with a smooth finish for the Trojans.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kayleigh Heckel joins the fast-break fun for USC) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Zyanna Walker's pull-up middy brings Kansas State within 2
videos.description: Zyanna Walker knocks down a smooth midrange jumper to cut into the USC lead.
